about_the_game:
LISTEN TO YOUR SANCTUARY - Craft a musical experience to listen to, uniquely your own with the Diablo® IV Original Soundtrack.

Relive the endless battle between the High Heavens and the Burning Hells with the Diablo® IV Original Soundtrack. With ceaseless demons to slaughter, countless abilities to master, nightmarish dungeons and legendary loot, the Soundtrack from the vast, open world of Diablo® IV perfectly scores the adventure and devastation.

During this time, and working with our team of composers, we recorded musicians from around the globe, with each original talent contributing distinct performances and contributing to the incredible depth of the scores. With an all-new musical landscape tailored to Diablo®, you’ll find your all your favorite tracks from your Diablo® IV experience, from Boss Fights to Dungeon Crawls, Cinematics and everything in between.

Make the Music of Diablo® IV the timeless soundtrack to your own Stronghold for enjoyment free from Lilith’s age of darkness and misery.
